reason: Egg can resolve a unique project container name and show safe details, but it has no pod address, node, or per-container restart details.

flags.name: namespace
flags.description: Namespace containing the pod; otherwise use the scoped project's namespace.

reason: Egg does not provide per-container runtime logs or a per-container streaming endpoint.

spec.summary: Read a pod's runtime logs, optionally selecting a container, older instance, line count, or continuous follow mode.

flags.name: namespace
flags.description: Namespace containing the pod; otherwise use the scoped project's namespace.

flags.name: container
flags.description: Container name within the pod.

flags.name: tail
flags.description: Maximum number of recent lines to return.

flags.name: previous
flags.description: Read logs from the prior terminated container instance.

reason: Egg has no endpoint for deleting or killing an individual container.

flags.name: namespace
flags.description: Namespace containing the pod; otherwise use the scoped project's namespace.

flags.name: confirm
flags.description: Must exactly match the pod name to authorize deletion.

reason: Egg has no endpoint for running a command inside a container.

flags.name: namespace
flags.description: Namespace containing the pod; otherwise use the scoped project's namespace.

flags.name: container
flags.description: Container in the pod; otherwise use its first container.

reason: Egg does not expose an interactive session or shell inside a container.

flags.name: namespace
flags.description: Namespace containing the pod; otherwise use the scoped project's namespace.

flags.name: container
flags.description: Container in the pod; otherwise use its first container.

flags.name: pod
flags.description: Pod to use; otherwise choose a ready pod.

flags.name: repl

flags.name: detach

flags.name: wait

flags.name: timeout
